title: The Power of Time
author: Minati Pradhan
text:
‎Unmeasurable is its power,
‎Some say it`s a measure of change,
‎Some call it an absolute reality range.
‎
‎Neither is it dependent on you,
‎Nor is it absolutely independent-
‎An all-encompassing universal resource.
‎
‎Time also destroys...
‎Brings truth and resilience to play,
‎Reconciliation and acceptance.
‎
‎Wounds heal...
‎And grief awakens,
‎By the paradoxical healer.
‎
‎It`s irreversible,
‎Despite all the inventions
‎And discoveries humans have made.
‎
‎Once it slips through your fingers,
‎You find remorse in your palm-
‎That is the power, and it is timeless.
stanzas: ‎Some say it`s a measure of change,
‎Some call it an absolute reality range.
‎That is the power, and it is timeless.
